name: xaviersobased
label: Atlantic
lede: A Manhattan kid trades a gaming headset for a microphone, uploads 'patchmade', and ends up on Atlantic with a debut album that Pitchfork scored 8.3.

eras.title: A kid on the Upper West Side
eras.text: Xavier Lopez grew up in a Manhattan family that had lived on the Upper West Side for four decades, with a DJ mother and a DJ brother. The internet did the rest of the teaching.

years.src: Wikipedia: Xaviersobased · The FADER: Cover Story
yt: A day with xaviersobased on the Upper West Side
years.h: At ten, YouTube autoplay lands him on Yung Lean's 'Hurt'
years.p: The rabbit hole runs through Lil B, Bladee and Black Kray. Lopez has since added Chief Keef, Hi-C and Duwap Kaine to the list.
years.xp:
Lopez was born October 23, 2003, on the Upper West Side. His older brother, who DJs as Nurse, had already handed him skateboarding, Odd Future and A$AP Rocky. Yung Lean's 2013 video for 'Hurt' was the first step down the cloud-rap and digicore hole.

He told The FADER the neighborhood is "still at the ending stages of gentrification. So it's a weird in-between."

q: It means effortless swag and positivity.
years.src: The FADER: Cover Story · Wikipedia: Xaviersobased
years.h: He uploads a first beat at twelve under a name from an old iCloud account
years.p: It is an FL Studio demo, and the name nods to Lil B's idea of being based.
years.xp: Lopez downloaded FL Studio after watching Lex Luger make a beat, and put the first one on SoundCloud in 2016. He joined the online rap collectives [[Novagang|ed733f70-2be1-4352-aa3f-f12b770653fa]] and Jewelxxet in these years, releasing tapes and EPs on SoundCloud.

eras.title: A gaming clan with a mic
eras.text: Lockdown turns a Tony Hawk's Underground Pro friend group into the collective that gets credited with a genre.

years.src: The FADER: Cover Story · Wikipedia: Xaviersobased
years.h: A Tony Hawk's Underground Pro clan turns into 1c34
years.p: Friends including [[Ksuuvi|25f406de-7368-49f0-b4ef-eb64ffbc0b61]] and Backend start as a gaming clan during COVID lockdowns, then turn to music.
years.xp:
According to The FADER, 1c34 'began as a gaming clan' before it became a music crew. Wikipedia credits the group with pioneering the jerk microgenre of the 2020s. Wikipedia's collective overview dates 1c34 to 2021, while Lopez's biography dates the formation to 2020.

On lockdown, he told The FADER: "I didn't see concrete for six months."

eras.title: The year 'patchmade' got loose
eras.text: One song catches on without courting the algorithm, and a New York scene forms around it.

years.src: Wikipedia: Xaviersobased · The FADER: Cover Story
years.h: Install brings 'patchmade', and TikTok fan edits do the rest
years.p: Kashpaint produced it. The Face called it a jerk anthem; Rolling Stone called it a passing headrush.
years.xp:
The FADER describes 'patchmade' as a proto-jerk song built on piano chords and drum kicks. Lopez says he never chased the algorithm: "I never really played into it... That's why it grew how it grew."

DJ Rennessy first saw him play at an East River park show on July 3, 2022, and told The FADER: "I was like I need to know who this kid is."

years.cap: Xaviersobased on stage in a red cap and pink tee, February 2, 2023
years.src: The FADER: Novagang · The FADER: Song You Need
years.h: [[Novagang|ed733f70-2be1-4352-aa3f-f12b770653fa]] drops H.T.N.G. Vol 2 two weeks before a sold-out New York show
years.p: [[osquinn|46a0eeec-1137-4303-85eb-ad11addbe5e4]] and xaviersobased headline the show, which sells out.
years.xp: The FADER describes Novagang as an outsider crew that rejects the label hyperpop, with xaviersobased and osquinn among its central acts. A month later the site picked his track 'fuck the city up' from Stash Muzik as a Song You Need.

eras.title: Keep it goin
eras.text: Two mixtapes and a leak put a SoundCloud regular in front of Pitchfork.

years.h: '40' with [[Nettspend|4585749c-5489-4699-9daf-1ffa9717179f]] and [[Evilgiane|18cf137c-6d0f-4e9b-ab9a-a2cc96283ad9]], then a freestyle a day later
years.p: '40' came out January 11. On January 12 he freestyled for the online show On the Radar; it was later released as 'Special'.

years.cap: Xaviersobased with a mic, hoodie and scarf at a live show
years.src: Pitchfork: Keep It Goin Xav · Wikipedia: Xaviersobased
years.h: Keep It Goin Xav goes up on SoundCloud with [[DJ Rennessy|ed000c84-a712-47e7-a14c-2de888c6e3be]] hosting
years.p: Fifteen tracks, with Nettspend, Yhapojj, Jtxpo and Kuru as guests. Pitchfork's Alphonse Pierre called it vibrant, improvisatory and fun as hell.
years.xp: Pierre wrote that Xaviersobased keeps a strong New York rap identity despite his amorphous influences. It was a SoundCloud-exclusive release.

years.big: "It's sweet to watch someone who doesn't give a fuck."
years.h: A week after the leak, With 2 comes out unfinished
years.p: Kieran Press-Reynolds wrote that line in Pitchfork's review. Wikipedia says the tape leaked a week earlier and went out half-finished.
years.xp: The quote is as printed in Pitchfork's review of With 2. Some sources give the release only as June 2024; Wikipedia gives June 5.

eras.title: From an OsamaSon EP to an Atlantic deal
eras.text: He co-writes a rage-meets-jerk EP with OsamaSon, adds guitars, and signs to a major.

years.cap: Xaviersobased live for Surf Gang x NTS: Miami, c. 2025
years.h: A year of working together becomes #BASEDSLiME with [[OsamaSon|35214d53-009b-45d9-8a00-6664325b9e2a]]
years.p: Four tracks, two of them new: 'whole lotta' and 'Shitshow', which ok produced. DJ Rennessy hosts.
years.xp: The FADER framed it as mutual respect: OsamaSon had paid homage to Xaviersobased on the site's Would You Rather? series, and the pair had teamed up for a year or so already.

years.src: The Face: Xaviersobased and Osamason · Wikipedia: Xaviersobased · Pitchfork: Once More
years.h: Once More wraps him in shoegaze guitars
years.p: The Face heard him and OsamaSon on 'Uncomfy' outrunning a mushy shoegaze backdrop. It is his first release as an Atlantic signee.
years.xp: Wikipedia dates the Atlantic signing to 2025 without a month. The Face called him one of the most compelling experimentalists in contemporary rap, and described the EP as a warm-up for album mode.

eras.title: Xavier
eras.text: A debut album under his own name, with Surf Gang, 1-chance and Atlantic on the credits.

years.src: Wikipedia: Xavier · NME: Xaviersobased · The FADER: Cover Story
years.h: Twenty tracks later, Xavier gets an 8.3 from Pitchfork
years.p: Lead single 'iPhone 16' came out a week earlier, on January 23.
years.xp:
Wikipedia lists features from Skrillex, OsamaSon, Zaytoven, Rio da Yung OG and Dylan Brady, and production from Eddiepoz, Ss3bby, [[Ksuuvi|25f406de-7368-49f0-b4ef-eb64ffbc0b61]] and Yung Sherman. NME picked out 'Clorox' and 'Heartfelt'. The FADER released a documentary, Keep It Goin', on February 13.

On the sound, he told The FADER he wanted to "package it better" rather than make it more accessible.

years.cap: Xaviersobased on stage at Rolling Loud Orlando, 2026
years.h: Riverside 2.0 tour, then 14 dates opening for Ken Carson
years.p: U.S. and European dates in March and April, then 14 U.S. shows opening for Ken Carson from August 26 to September 23.
